name: Cuepoint
summary: A work planner for a small podcast studio: episode board, waveform cue points, calendar and guests
about: A complete work planner for a small team that makes podcasts, with three sample shows, their episodes, guests, sponsors and editing hours. A waveform player lets you play an episode and drag its chapter cue points into place, episodes move across a production board, and an edit timer tracks hours against an edit-ratio target. Good for a podcast or video studio, a radio team or any small media crew.
how: On air opens the waveform of the episode being edited. Press play, click or drag on the waveform to seek, and drag a cue flag to move a chapter. Add a cue at the playhead or copy the chapters.
On Episodes, drag an episode from Idea through Recorded and Editing to Published, or use the ⋯ menu. Filter by show.
On Calendar, drag recording sessions and publish days to new dates. Click a date to plan an episode recording.
On Edit log, pick an episode and start the timer. It runs in the top bar on every page and logs the time when you stop it.
On Guests, pitch someone with a ready-made message, mark who said yes and plan their episode. Shows has listens with 7D, 30D and 12M and sponsor reads.
Open any episode for its details, chapters, files and notes. Settings has the edit-ratio target, alerts, the neon dark theme and Reset demo data.
